Safety and Compliance Notice

This audio guide provides orientational directions and in no way substitutes compliance with current traffic regulations. The user is responsible for respecting traffic signs, traffic rules, and actual road conditions at all times.

In particular, it is noted that, in accordance with the Mobility Ordinance of the City of València (for example, its article 87), it is not permitted to ride bicycles or personal mobility vehicles on pavements and pedestrian areas, except in expressly designated spaces.

Furthermore, geolocation systems may present slight inaccuracies or delays, so some directions may not correspond exactly to the appropriate points for travelling or crossing. Therefore, it is recommended to always follow the actual signage and to use only authorised crossings and routes.

Upon reaching the indicated points, content activation may require a few additional seconds due to possible GPS signal delays.

Use of the audio guide implies acceptance of these conditions, with exempt from liability in the event of non-compliance with regulations or improper use of the application.
